items.message: `report.fix.paths()` assertion relies on the fix step writing exactly `calc.py` — there is no test for the case where the reproduce step stages non-test changes but the fix step stages nothing at all.
The test asserts `report.fix.paths() == ('calc.py',)` but does not assert that `report.reproducer` does not contain `calc.py`, leaving open whether the split in `fix.py` actually excludes it.
